binding_scope: Algorithm, argument layout, distinctive control flow, and pinned upstream source identify candidate static bodies. These are attribution leads, not whole-function stock/source equivalence receipts.

bindings.basis: Eight-argument cache/block/off/buffer/size shape; alignment, cache and backend read branches.
Four-argument cache flush, invalid-block bypass, aligned backend program, optional cache-drop/readback compare, corrupt result and cache-zero sequence match pinned LittleFS source.
Eight-argument lfs/pcache/rcache/validate/block/off/buffer/size shape; cache alignment, copy, full-cache flush and backend program branches match pinned LittleFS source.
Ten-argument lfs/dir/pcache/rcache/hint/gmask/gtag/off/buffer/size shape; inline pcache and rcache precedence, read alignment and lfs_dir_getslice child match pinned LittleFS source.
Lookahead start/next/size scan with bitmap bit tests, block modulo and rescan child matches pinned LittleFS allocation body.
Seven-argument gmask/gtag/goff/buffer/size shape; synthetic move tag and reverse directory scan.
Thirteen-argument tag traversal with bounded recursive stack, tag filtering and callback.
Eight-argument pair/fmask/ftag/id/callback shape and metadata CRC/tag scan.
Four-argument path pointer and id; root-pair initialization and empty path rejection.
Two-argument commit pointer; five-word CRC alignment and 0x3fe chunk cap.
Seven-argument attrs/source/begin/end compact body and commit loop.
Seven-argument split compact body, span halving and compact child.
Six-argument pair/attrs/count/pdir relocation state and compact/split children.
Four-argument attrs/count; orphan relocation and commit children.
Two-argument path; find, allocate, parent commit and directory metadata construction.
Seven-argument caches/head/size/output shape; allocate/erase/CTZ extension loop.

Seven-argument CTZ head/size/callback/data shape; index count from lfs_ctz_index, callback on head and fetched little-endian parent blocks, then decrement by pointer-word count match pinned LittleFS source.
Two-argument file relocation loop allocates and erases a new block, copies file bytes, then moves cache and block state; matches pinned LittleFS source.
Two-argument file flush clears reading, copies trailing data, flushes program cache with corrupt-block relocation, then updates CTZ and flags; matches pinned LittleFS source.
Two-argument sync checks errored/dirty flags, flushes file, syncs block and commits inline or CTZ metadata; matches pinned LittleFS source.
Four-argument file read caps at CTZ size, resolves block/inline branches, reads and advances file position; matches pinned LittleFS source.
Five-argument lfs/file/path/flags/config shape; initializes file fields and finds path.
Four-argument file/buffer/size; inline outline and block extension write loop.
Configuration validation, cache and lookahead initialization at matching lfs object offsets.
Two-argument format begins with lfs_init, sets lookahead, allocates root and commits LittleFS superblock; matches pinned upstream source.
Calls lfs_init and scans root metadata/superblock before mount completion.
Four-argument callback/data/includeorphans shape and directory traversal with block callback.
lfs/bool shape; orphan directory scan, fetch and relocation/commit handling.

Native private read asserts file flags bit0 at retained upstream line3556 (0xde4), flushes a dirty file through child 0x4139a4 when needed, then calls read body 0x413b92 with lfs/file/buffer/size. Pinned LittleFS lfs_file_read_ has this same entry sequence.

Native private write asserts LFS_O_WRONLY at pinned upstream line3659, flushes pending read state through 0x4139a4, handles append position and file max; pinned LittleFS lfs_file_write_ has the same entry structure and full upstream body.

Native private file-open default adapter loads read-only zeroed lfs_file_config at 0x433f98, passes it as fifth argument to pinned lfs_file_opencfg_ at 0x413586, returns status. Pinned upstream lfs_file_open_ defines static zero defaults and calls opencfg_ with the same arguments.
Native private unmount adapter calls deinit at 0x4144dc and returns; pinned LittleFS lfs_unmount_ returns lfs_deinit(lfs). Public 0x41513c wrapper calls this adapter.

Native body starts with lfs_tag_dsize(tag), checks commit->off+dsize against commit->end, writes normalized tag through commitprog, then selects in-memory or disk-byte read/commit loop based on tag high bit. Pinned upstream lfs_dir_commitattr at line1623 has the same argument shape and branch sequence.

Native body first tests lfs_gstate_hasmove(gdisk) at lfs+0x3c, logs Fixing move using pair/tag at pinned line4961, asserts tag type at line4965, then fetches/deletes moved entry. Pinned LittleFS lfs_fs_demove has this exact source structure.

Native private directory open receives lfs/dir/path, calls dir_find with dir->m and path cursor, rejects non-directory tag, uses root pair for id0x3ff or fetches parent struct pair, then fetches first pair and initializes directory head. Pinned LittleFS lfs_dir_open_ at line2722 has this sequence.

Native eight-argument lfs/pcache/rcache/head/size/pos/block/off helper handles size0 by writing null block and zero offset, computes current and target CTZ indices through 0x413234, traverses disk links through bd_read, then writes block/off. Pinned LittleFS lfs_ctz_find at line2887 has the same algorithm.

Native two-block reversed allocation, revision disk read/corrupt acceptance, block-cycle alignment, and directory defaults match pinned selected LittleFS lfs_dir_alloc at lfs.c:1817. Static source attribution; runtime I/O effects and compiler layout not independently oracle-qualified.

Native SET/CUR/END position choice, file_max rejection, same-position return, reading cache CTZ shortcut, flush and position update match pinned selected LittleFS lfs_file_seek_ at lfs.c:3701. Static source attribution; I/O effects and compiler layout not independently oracle-qualified.
